name: Parallel
summary: Parallel offers web APIs for AI agents: Search, Extract, a Task API for structured deep research with citations, FindAll for building entity datasets, and Monitor for tracking web changes. It also has an OpenAI-compatible Responses/Chat API and a search MCP server.
facts: Search, Extract, Task, FindAll, Monitor, Responses
EU option for Search and Extract (Oct 2026)
goodFor: Deep research with citations and confidence scores
Building lists of companies or people from a query
watchOut: Higher Task processors cost much more per request
Async research runs take longer than plain search
